pages.title: @block chip
pages.description: A chip naming a block by its type and opening text, in a paragraph or a comment; with href it scrolls to the block and selects it.
pages.usage:
import { BlockMention } from '@tmt/browser-ui/blocks';

<BlockMention icon={<Table2 />} href="#b-6">Table: Ticket status</BlockMention>

pages.title: Alert
pages.description: A callout in the flow of the page: a method note, a caveat or a blocking problem.
pages.usage:
import { Alert, AlertTitle, AlertDescription } from '@tmt/browser-ui/ui';

<Alert>
  <AlertTitle>Method</AlertTitle>
  <AlertDescription>…</AlertDescription>
</Alert>

pages.title: Badge
pages.description: A short label for a kind, audience or state. Neutral by default; a state badge carries its mark and word.
dos: Pair a state with its mark: ✕ Blocked, ◆ Waiting.
Fill a badge with the accent red; red fills belong to the primary action.

pages.title: Block document
pages.description: The page column the blocks sit in: it holds the gutter for the one shared handle and is the container whose width decides the phone layout (480px), so a block page in a narrow pane collapses like a phone. Its stylesheet carries every block part.
pages.usage:
import { BlockDocument, Block, TextBlock } from '@tmt/browser-ui/blocks';

<BlockDocument>
  <Block label="Paragraph: Blocks read as one document"><TextBlock>…</TextBlock></Block>
</BlockDocument>

pages.title: Block menus
pages.description: BlockMenu is the insert menu (a listbox opened by / or the handle’s +, filtered as the person types) and, with kind="actions", the block menu (Move to…, Move up, Move down, Duplicate, Copy link to block, @ this block in a comment, Delete; never "turn into"). Focus stays in the editor: the host drives the active item with nextBlockMenuItem and names it with activeId. On a phone it is a bottom sheet with 44px rows. insertGroups is the one catalog of insert types (icon, description, shortcut, group); items draws catalog rows by label, which is how the block-menu tag shows the same rows.
pages.usage: import { BlockMenu, BlockMenuGroup, BlockMenuItem, BlockMenuSeparator, BlockMenuEmpty, BlockMenuFooter, BlockKbd, blockActions, insertGroups, nextBlockMenuItem } from '@tmt/browser-ui/blocks'; Basic } description="Columns and rows" shortcut="/table" active>Table {!matches.length && No block matches.} ↑↓ choose {blockActions.map((action) => {action.label})} // BlockMenuSeparator goes before Delete // rows from insertGroups

pages.title: Block shell
pages.description: Every block sits in the shell, and the shell draws nothing at rest: no border, fill or box, so the page reads as one document. Hover gives a light tint and selection a deeper one, never a border; the focus ring shows only for the keyboard. Each editor renders one BlockHandle (insert and the block menu, which is also the drag grip) inside the hovered or focused block, in the gutter 8px to its left. Under 480px of document width the handle hides: a tap selects and a long press opens the block menu as a sheet.
dos: Render one handle per editor and move it to the hovered or focused block.
Draw a border or a resting fill around a block; only the card block has a frame.

pages.title: Button
pages.description: Starts an action. One primary button per surface takes the accent; everything else is outline, secondary or ghost.
dos: Use one primary button for the action the surface exists for.
Fill a destructive action with red. Delete is outlined text in the blocked colour.

pages.title: Callout block
pages.description: The shared tinted notice in four tones (working, waiting, review, blocked), each with its mark and word (calloutLabels) so colour is never alone; role note.
pages.usage:
import { Callout } from '@tmt/browser-ui/blocks';

<Callout tone="waiting" heading="Look before merging">The pull request stays a draft.</Callout>

pages.title: Card
pages.description: A resting surface for one object: the sheet fill, the rule and the surface radius, with no shadow.
pages.usage:
import { Card, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardContent } from '@tmt/browser-ui/ui';

<Card>
  <CardHeader><CardTitle>#sample-squad</CardTitle></CardHeader>
  <CardContent>…</CardContent>
</Card>
dos: Add a shadow to a resting card; only floating layers cast one.

pages.title: Card block
pages.description: The only block that nests (one level) and the only one that draws a frame; resting, it has no shadow. The section variant is a label with no frame, to group cards.
pages.usage:
import { CardBlock } from '@tmt/browser-ui/blocks';

<CardBlock title="First block set" meta="3 blocks">{children}</CardBlock>

pages.title: Checkbox
pages.description: Turns one option on or off inside a form; checked takes the accent.
pages.usage:
import { Checkbox } from '@tmt/browser-ui/ui';

<Checkbox defaultChecked aria-label="Show comments" />

pages.title: Chips and combobox
pages.description: Chips holds a set of choices as small pills with a round remove, added from a combobox; Combobox picks one option from a filtered list. Backspace in an empty field removes the last chip. A chip owns its size, so no host control rule grows it.

pages.title: Code block
pages.description: A header with the filename (cut with an ellipsis), the language and Copy, over wrapped monospace text; the host copies and sets copied. variant="command" is the shared one-line command.
pages.usage:
import { CodeBlock } from '@tmt/browser-ui/blocks';

<CodeBlock filename="answered-strip.css" language="CSS" text={source} onCopy={copy} copied={copied} />

pages.title: Command
pages.description: A searchable list of commands or destinations, the base of quick switchers.
pages.usage:
import { Command, CommandInput, CommandList, CommandItem } from '@tmt/browser-ui/ui';

<Command>
  <CommandInput placeholder="Search" />
  <CommandList><CommandItem>Release plan</CommandItem></CommandList>
</Command>

pages.title: Data table
pages.description: The dense table for lists such as the Colab page list: declared columns with a role and widths, a reserved actions column so hover actions never cover a cell, every cell on the first line so a sub-line never moves the menu, a sticky sortable header, selection with a bulk bar, loading, empty and error rows, and two-line cards under 760px (dataTablePhoneWidth). It ships in its own entry with its stylesheet.

pages.title: Dialog
pages.description: A modal question that blocks the page until it is answered. Keep it to one decision.
pages.usage:
import { Dialog, DialogTrigger, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle } from '@tmt/browser-ui/ui';

<Dialog>
  <DialogTrigger asChild><Button type="button">Move</Button></DialogTrigger>
  <DialogContent>
    <DialogHeader><DialogTitle>Move to project</DialogTitle></DialogHeader>
  </DialogContent>
</Dialog>
dos: Name the action on the confirm button: “Move”, not “OK”.

pages.title: Dropdown menu
pages.description: A short list of commands on one object, opened from a button.
pages.usage:
import { DropdownMenu, DropdownMenuTrigger, DropdownMenuContent, DropdownMenuItem } from '@tmt/browser-ui/ui';

<DropdownMenu>
  <DropdownMenuTrigger asChild><Button type="button">Page actions</Button></DropdownMenuTrigger>
  <DropdownMenuContent><DropdownMenuItem>Rename</DropdownMenuItem></DropdownMenuContent>
</DropdownMenu>

pages.title: DsScope
pages.description: A sized stage that confines component layers, responsive layout and modal effects.
pages.usage:
import { DsScope, Button } from '@tmt/browser-ui/ui';

<DsScope style={{ width: '100%', height: 320 }}><Button>Action</Button></DsScope>

pages.title: Empty
pages.description: What a list shows when it has nothing yet, with one way forward.
pages.usage:
import { Empty, EmptyHeader, EmptyTitle, EmptyDescription } from '@tmt/browser-ui/ui';

<Empty>
  <EmptyHeader><EmptyTitle>No timers yet</EmptyTitle></EmptyHeader>
</Empty>

pages.title: Floating actions and window
pages.description: FloatingDock places a page’s floating actions at the bottom end and the one window an action opens above them. FloatingActions is the capsule; FloatingAction an action with its count and attention dot, pressed while its window is open. FloatingWindow sizes to its content up to the space above the actions.
pages.usage:
import { FloatingDock, FloatingActions, FloatingAction, FloatingWindow, FloatingWindowAction } from '@tmt/browser-ui/ui';

<FloatingDock top={headerHeight}>
  {open && (
    <FloatingWindow key={open} open label="Discussion" onClose={close} header={<>…<FloatingWindowAction label="Resolve" icon={<Check />} /></>}>
      …
    </FloatingWindow>
  )}
  <FloatingActions label="Page actions">
    <FloatingAction label="Comments (2)" icon={<MessagesSquare />} count={2} expanded={open === 'comments'} onClick={toggle} />
  </FloatingActions>
</FloatingDock>

pages.title: Heading block
pages.description: ## and ### only: the page title is the GUI header’s, never a block. Long headings wrap.
pages.usage:
import { HeadingBlock } from '@tmt/browser-ui/blocks';

<HeadingBlock level={2}>First block set</HeadingBlock>

pages.title: Image block
pages.description: A compact image collection with captions, a viewer and optional file cards.

pages.title: Input
pages.description: A single-line field. Its frame is the soft rule; focus recolours the frame in the accent.
pages.usage:
import { Input } from '@tmt/browser-ui/ui';

<Input aria-label="Search agents" placeholder="Search agents" />

pages.title: List item block
pages.description: One item is one block, so each moves and is mentioned on its own. Bullet or number, three indent levels (24px each, 16px on a phone).
pages.usage:
import { ListItemBlock } from '@tmt/browser-ui/blocks';

<ListItemBlock indent={1}>A nested item</ListItemBlock>

pages.title: Marked text
pages.description: A block’s text with its inline marks: bold, italic and inline code, a link, and @agent or @block mentions. Offsets count scalar values. A link draws only for an https, http or mailto URL (linkHref) and opens through the host’s onLink; anything else is plain text.

pages.title: Mockup block
pages.description: A sized design-system stage with device widths and theme controls.

pages.title: Page list
pages.description: Pinned page cards and project and stage chips for the Colab page list. The host owns links, data and actions.
pages.usage:
import { PageListPins, PageListProjectChip, PageListStageChip, PageListTabs, PageListControls, PageListBulkActions, PageListRowMenu, PageListProjectPicker, PageListLoading, PageListError, PageListTable } from '@tmt/browser-ui/data-table';

<PageListPins label="Pinned pages" pages={pages} />

pages.title: Page view
pages.description: Filter, group and choose visible columns for a shared page list. PageViewToolbar provides the controls; the host owns the data. authoredPageViewRows reads a view’s authored rows as plain values, filtered, sorted and cut at its limit.

pages.title: Paragraph block
pages.description: Plain text with a few inline formats (bold, italic, inline code, links, @agent and @block chips), default or muted; empty, it shows its placeholder.
pages.usage:
import { TextBlock } from '@tmt/browser-ui/blocks';

<TextBlock tone="muted">Secondary notes</TextBlock>

pages.title: Popover
pages.description: Detail or a small form anchored to its trigger; it does not block the page.
pages.usage:
import { Popover, PopoverTrigger, PopoverContent } from '@tmt/browser-ui/ui';

<Popover>
  <PopoverTrigger asChild><Button type="button">Details</Button></PopoverTrigger>
  <PopoverContent>…</PopoverContent>
</Popover>

pages.title: Question block
pages.description: A presentational question with choices or a short answer; Other provides a text answer. In Colab, use tmt-question for persistent questions and answers.

pages.title: Rich input
pages.description: One Lexical editor in two shapes: the single-line search with filter chips and the multi-line composer with mentions, a toolbar and an attachment slot. It ships in its own entry, so pages without it never load Lexical.

pages.title: Select
pages.description: Picks one value from a short list. The trigger is a field; the list opens as a popper under it.
pages.usage:
import { Select, SelectTrigger, SelectValue, SelectContent, SelectItem } from '@tmt/browser-ui/ui';

<Select defaultValue="1d">
  <SelectTrigger aria-label="Range"><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger>
  <SelectContent>
    <SelectItem value="1h">Range 1h</SelectItem>
    <SelectItem value="1d">Range 1d</SelectItem>
  </SelectContent>
</Select>
dos: Use a native select; the list must take the tokens and the theme.

pages.title: Separator
pages.description: A hairline between groups of content.
pages.usage:
import { Separator } from '@tmt/browser-ui/ui';

<Separator />

pages.title: Sheet
pages.description: A drawer from the edge for settings and detail that keep the page in view.
pages.usage:
import { Sheet, SheetTrigger, SheetContent } from '@tmt/browser-ui/ui';

<Sheet>
  <SheetTrigger asChild><Button type="button">Open</Button></SheetTrigger>
  <SheetContent side="right">…</SheetContent>
</Sheet>

pages.title: Skeleton
pages.description: A quiet placeholder while content loads. It does not pulse; a busy action uses the busy mark.
pages.usage:
import { Skeleton } from '@tmt/browser-ui/ui';

<Skeleton className="h-3 w-40" />

pages.title: Surface
pages.description: A box at one elevation level: paper, sheet, raised, overlay or modal. Each pairs a fill with a hairline edge and one shadow level, since dark themes show shadows weakly.
pages.usage:
import { Surface } from '@tmt/browser-ui/ui';

<Surface level="sheet">…</Surface>

pages.title: Switch
pages.description: Turns a setting on or off at once, without a save step.
pages.usage:
import { Switch } from '@tmt/browser-ui/ui';

<Switch checked={on} onCheckedChange={setOn} aria-label="Notify me" />

pages.title: Table block
pages.description: The shared table. A column marked hideNarrow leaves the view while the block itself is narrower than 480px (a container query, not the viewport); its cells stay in the DOM. Tall tables scroll inside the block.
pages.usage:
import { TableBlock } from '@tmt/browser-ui/blocks';

<TableBlock label="Ticket status" columns={[{ name: 'Ticket', nowrap: true }, { name: 'Note', hideNarrow: true }]} rows={rows} />

pages.title: Tabs
pages.description: Switches between views of the same object. The selected tab carries the accent underline; its text stays the foreground.
pages.usage:
import { Tabs, TabsList, TabsTrigger, TabsContent } from '@tmt/browser-ui/ui';

<Tabs defaultValue="members">
  <TabsList variant="line">
    <TabsTrigger value="members">Members</TabsTrigger>
    <TabsTrigger value="timers">Timers</TabsTrigger>
  </TabsList>
  <TabsContent value="members">…</TabsContent>
</Tabs>

pages.title: Textarea
pages.description: A multi-line field for messages and notes.
pages.usage:
import { Textarea } from '@tmt/browser-ui/ui';

<Textarea aria-label="Message" placeholder="Message #sample-squad" />

pages.title: To-do block
pages.description: The shared checkbox and the item text, struck through when done, with an assignee and a due date; overdue adds the blocked colour to text that already says so. On a phone the meta moves under the text.
pages.usage:
import { TodoBlock } from '@tmt/browser-ui/blocks';

<TodoBlock checked assignee={<Tag>gui-3</Tag>} due="11-03">Move the question card</TodoBlock>

pages.title: Tooltip
pages.description: Names an icon-only control on hover and focus. Never the only place for content.
pages.usage:
import { Tooltip, TooltipProvider, TooltipTrigger, TooltipContent } from '@tmt/browser-ui/ui';

<Tooltip>
  <TooltipTrigger asChild>…</TooltipTrigger>
  <TooltipContent>Search pages</TooltipContent>
</Tooltip>

pages.title: Undo toast
pages.description: The status line after a delete or a move, with Undo and its key. The host places it at the bottom centre, times it out and restores the blocks; Cmd/Ctrl+Z does the same.
pages.usage:
import { BlockToast } from '@tmt/browser-ui/blocks';

<BlockToast onUndo={restore}>Deleted 1 block (Table)</BlockToast>

pages.title: Work bundle
pages.description: A page reference with its admitted metadata and independently retained work. ConnectedWorkBundle subscribes through the host’s read-only source.

pages.title: Action
pages.description: The Browser action button in its primary, secondary, text and danger variants, with busy and disabled states.

pages.title: Avatar
pages.description: Initials on a seat colour for a person or agent; avatarInitials derives them.

pages.title: Brand mark
pages.description: The tmt mark and the lockup with the wordmark, drawn from the brand-mark roles.

pages.title: Busy mark
pages.description: The busy dots. useBusyMark waits busyMarkDelayMs before showing and holds busyMarkHoldMs once shown, so a quick action never flickers.

pages.title: Card and meter
pages.description: The static card with a meter and its glyphs and a small chart.

pages.title: Chart
pages.description: Bar, line and stacked charts on the chart roles, with axes, legend and tooltip.

pages.title: Checkbox (Browser)
pages.description: The Browser checkbox with its label, mixed and disabled states.

pages.title: Chips (Browser)
pages.description: Chips with an add popup and remove controls, and state chips with a mark and word.

pages.title: Choice
pages.description: Single and multiple choice rows for a question, with an Other answer.

pages.title: Command (Browser)
pages.description: The command field with its results list and keyboard selection.

pages.title: Count chip
pages.description: A number with its tone: neutral, waiting or blocked; countText formats it.

pages.title: Dialog, drawer and panel
pages.description: The Browser dialog (modal and confirm), drawer and non-modal panel, with the drawer header, Esc and focus return.

pages.title: Disclosure
pages.description: A summary that opens more detail in place.

pages.title: Editorial prose
pages.description: Long-form prose on the type ramp: headings, lists, quotes, code and tables.

pages.title: Field
pages.description: A labelled control with its help and error text and the field edge and focus.

pages.title: Header
pages.description: The page header: title, caption and actions on the header metrics.

pages.title: Icon action
pages.description: A square action named by its tooltip label; text and filled variants.

pages.title: List and list table
pages.description: Rows with a lead, title, meta and actions, the list table with its column rules and the page subheader.

pages.title: Menu
pages.description: The Browser menu and its host for non-React pages: items, radio and checkbox items, disabled rows and submenus.

pages.title: Message row
pages.description: A message with its author and delivery or recovery state.

pages.title: Notice
pages.description: A card-level message with a tone mark, heading, body and actions.

pages.title: Notifications
pages.description: Transient notifications stacked at the corner, with their actions and dismissal.

pages.title: Overview pieces
pages.description: The page head, banner, facts, stats and state marks an overview page composes, with the shared glyphs.

pages.title: Page row
pages.description: A page title, tags, update time and optional unread or status mark.

pages.title: Pager
pages.description: Previous and next with the position, for a list longer than a page.

pages.title: Section
pages.description: A titled page section with its rule and spacing.

pages.title: Shell and rail
pages.description: The product frame: the top bar, the module rail with its menus, counts and attention dot, and the content slot. Hover and drag reveal row actions with the swap crossfade.

pages.title: Status line
pages.description: A row of state marks with their accessible labels.

pages.title: Status tile
pages.description: A state with its mark, word and count, alone or as a row of tiles.

pages.title: Table
pages.description: A data table with its header, numeric columns and compact scroll.

pages.title: Tabs (Browser)
pages.description: The Browser tabs with counts and wrapping. New work uses the ui Tabs and its TabsBar.

pages.title: Toggle
pages.description: A pressed or unpressed action, for a view setting that stays on.

pages.title: Visually hidden
pages.description: Text for assistive technology only, such as a count’s full sentence.

pages.title: Work band
pages.description: A page stage and expandable list of sub-page progress.
